blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — After nearly three decades without a podium finish, the Philippines returned to the top three at a WorldSkills International competition, with a young Batangueño showing that Filipino talent can hold its own on the global stage. Carlos Antonio Delos Reyes did not go to Shanghai expecting to bring home a medal. He returned with two major honors. Known for being highly competitive, Carlos approached this competition differently. He allowed himself to loosen up, embrace the uncertainty and enjoy the process. “I’m just gonna be myself.
